messages:
Sam: quick handoff — I'm wrapping up the swing shift, leaving a few active items below. TL;DR: partial canary stuck, one unhealthy GPU node, increased 5xxs from model-cpu-fallback.

Maya: noted. can you post the incidents + current mitigations?

Sam: INC-7213: canary deploy for 'redwood/llama-2-13b-v2' stuck in PENDING in eu-west1, started ~08:12 UTC. Kube events show ImagePullBackOff on canary pod-2. Tried restart, still PENDING. Mitigation: rolled traffic to stable via rollout rollback; metrics show tail-latency back to normal.

Priya: I'm looking at registry permissions, might be a transient auth flake with our image registry token rotation. If so, restarting the node pool controller should pick up new creds.

Andre: I'm on the node issue — node-ops-418 (g4dn.xlarge) OOMKilled on gpu-driver. Seeing repeated dmesg gpu resets. Isolate by cordoning and draining. Doing `kubectl drain node-ops-418 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

Lin: started cordon + drain. Adding `--grace-period=60` because some pods are large. ETA ~3m.

DevOpsBot: deploy-bot: rollback triggered for canary-redwood/llama-2-13b-v2 by @Sam at 2026-03-17T08:25:41Z :white_check_mark:

Sam: also seeing elevated 5xxs from model-cpu-fallback route (route: /v1/generate, shard eu-west1). Root cause: autoscaler briefly spun up CPU-only fallback instances and they timed out on long prompt sequences. Mitigation: increased timeout on fallback from 30s -> 90s and set max_tokens limit for that route to 2048.

Priya: pinging infra to re-run registry token job. @Andre will you hold on re-adding node until registry job finishes?

Andre: yup will hold. After cordon/drain I'll set node into maintenance and trigger a redeploy once registry job is green.

Maya: any customer-facing impact? support ticket queue?

Sam: partial impact to a small percentage of low-tier requests during the canary window. CS already notified — ticket #CS-4490 opened. No major customers affected.

Lin: logs snippet from canary pod before PENDING:
```
ImagePullBackOff: back-off pulling image "registry.internal/redwood/llama-2-13b-v2:canary-2026-03-17"
error: failed to resolve credentials: unexpected status 401
```

Priya: registry job is running now. If it finishes clean, we can re-attempt the canary after node stabilization. Recommend waiting 30m to observe if any additional OOMs.

Sam: next steps for night team:
- wait for registry job success (Priya)
- confirm node-ops-418 recovered or replace (Andre)
- when cluster healthy, re-run canary with reduced replica count (1) and health-check timeout extended (Lin)
- monitor 5xxs for 30m after canary (Maya)

Andre: documented commands I used: `kubectl cordon node-ops-418` then `kubectl drain node-ops-418 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60`

Maya: ack. I'll watch alerts and CS queue. If 5xxs spike >3% for 5m, escalate to bridge.

Priya: registry job finished: https://ci.internal/builds/registry-rotate/987 :white_check_mark:

Sam: thanks — leaving handoff in #eng-oncall. I'm reachable for 30m if anyone needs context. :wave:

OpsBot: shift-handoff: Sam -> Maya (swing->night) — noted items: INC-7213, node-ops-418, CS-4490. Reminder: update runbook if any permanent root cause found.

Maya: closing loop — will update this thread after re-add/canary attempt or earlier if anything changes.

Priya: I'll drop a follow-up if registry rotates again or we need a manual token bump.

Andre: node marked unschedulable, creating a replacement in eu-west1-asg.

Sam: thanks team, handing off.
